name: spar
description: Run independent review rounds on pinned commits with several reviewer CLIs, classify their findings, and record a review gate the agent can stop on.

interface.shortDescription: Independent review rounds with a recorded gate
interface.longDescription: Spar lets a coding agent send the same review packet, pinned to two commits, to every configured reviewer in parallel: Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLIs with read-only protections, an arbitrary command, or a clean-context subagent of the host. It classifies findings, limits how they may be closed, caps the number of rounds per stage and writes a review gate file through the spar binary. Start it with $spar:spar when a plan or a change needs an independent review.
